answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes. The way a bridge roots the soil, a ember returns each spring, and a trellis reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
